# Neurobiology of Emotion Blog | UT Dallas

> An academic blog exploring the neural mechanisms underlying emotion, behavior, and mental health through student-authored research articles.

Hosted by the University of Texas at Dallas, this blog features peer-reviewed student writing on neuroscience topics including emotion processing, trauma treatment, social media effects, and behavioral neurobiology. The site serves as both an educational resource and a platform for undergraduate and graduate research in cognitive and affective neuroscience.

## Key Topics

- Neurobiology of Emotion
- Amygdala
- Dopamine
- PTSD
- Vagus Nerve Stimulation
- Prefrontal Cortex
- HPA Axis
- Hippocampus
- Social Media Effects
- Brain Imaging
- Emotion Science
- Trauma Treatment
- Neuroscience Education
- Mental Health
- Behavioral Neuroscience

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://neblog.utdallas.edu): Homepage for UT Dallas Neurobiology of Emotion Blog covering neuroscience and mental health topics
- [About](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/about): Course overview and information about UT Dallas Neurobiology of Emotion program by Anna Taylor

## Trauma & Treatment

- [Healing The Trauma from Within: How Vagus Nerve Stimulation is Revolutionizing PTSD Treatment](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/2025/08/13/healingthetrauma): Robair Sedarous examines vagus nerve stimulation as innovative PTSD and trauma treatment approach

## Emotion & Brain Processing

- [Cortical Reaction to Crisis: How Media Shapes Emotional Processing](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/2025/08/14/corticalreaction): Aisha Subzwari explores media influence on amygdala and fear response during health crises
- [The Sound of Recovery: How Music Moves Us and Mends Us](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/2025/08/11/cortical-reaction-to-crisis-how-media-shapes-emotional-processing): Sofia Meinardus explores music therapy and neurorehabilitation through Joni Mitchell recovery case study

## Behavior & Neuroscience

- [Human Aggression: The causes, effects, and what we can do about it.](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/2025/08/12/humanaggression): Tushar Sunkum analyzes human aggression neurobiology using fMRI and behavioral neuroscience research
- [The Neuroscience of Bruxism](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/2025/08/14/the-neuroscience-of-bruxism): Teeth grinding neuroscience by Jason Ly examining motor cortex and stress-related sleep disorders

## Social Media & Psychology

- [The Fear of Missing Out (FoMO): How Social Media Hijacks Our Minds](https://neblog.utdallas.edu/2025/08/14/the-fear-of-missing-out-fomo-how-social-media-hijacks-our-minds): FoMO psychology analysis by Dhvani Sharma exploring social media effects on dopamine and anxiety
